checks.name: Service account token auto-mount disabled
checks.description: Prevents automatic injection of default API credentials into container pods.
checks.remediation: Set automountServiceAccountToken: false in pod spec.

checks.name: SPIFFE peer workload identity authorization
checks.description: Enforces cryptographically verifiable SPIFFE SVID peer authentication.
checks.remediation: Present valid SPIFFE SVID rooted in the Signal Loom trust domain.

checks.name: Host IPC namespace not shared
checks.description: PSS treats hostNetwork, hostPID and hostIPC as one Host Namespaces control and baseline forbids all three. Sharing the host IPC namespace exposes host shared memory and semaphores. Added by the lead after V3 built and mutation-proved it but could not land it from inside the pack: a Go test pinned the check count and the oracle group mapped two names. Frequency is NOT calibrated: this check was cloned from a sibling and inherited its triples verbatim, which priced host-namespace sharing at the same annual loss as an auto-mounted service-account token. Calibration is the principal's decision, so the frequency is zeroed and the check is declared unpriced.
checks.remediation: Remove spec.hostIPC (or set it false) so the pod does not share the host IPC namespace.

checks.name: Host PID namespace not shared
checks.description: PSS treats hostNetwork, hostPID and hostIPC as ONE Host Namespaces control and baseline forbids all three. This version checked none of them until the lead added no-host-ipc, which made the gap visible to the external PSA oracle as a hostPID-only divergence. Completing the control set is the honest fix: a partial cover of a single upstream control reports a host-namespace-sharing pod as compliant. Frequency is NOT calibrated: this check was cloned from a sibling and inherited its triples verbatim, which priced host-namespace sharing at the same annual loss as an auto-mounted service-account token. Calibration is the principal's decision, so the frequency is zeroed and the check is declared unpriced.
checks.remediation: Remove spec.hostPID (or set it false) so the pod does not share the host PID namespace.

checks.name: Cross-namespace network egress authorization
checks.description: Restricts inter-agent communication across namespace boundaries without explicit egress grant.
checks.celExpression: has(request.destination) && has(request.destination.namespace) && request.destination.namespace != '' && ((has(request.source) && has(request.source.namespace) && request.destination.namespace == request.source.namespace) || (has(request.context) && has(request.context.egress_authorized) && request.context.egress_authorized == true))
checks.remediation: Obtain cross-namespace authorization grant or isolate within local namespace.

checks.name: Container runs as non-root
checks.description: Enforces least privilege execution preventing root user execution.
checks.celExpression: has(object.spec) && has(object.spec.containers) && size(object.spec.containers) > 0 && !(has(object.spec.securityContext) && has(object.spec.securityContext.runAsNonRoot) && object.spec.securityContext.runAsNonRoot == false) && !(has(object.spec.securityContext) && has(object.spec.securityContext.runAsUser) && object.spec.securityContext.runAsUser == 0) && (object.spec.containers + (has(object.spec.initContainers) ? object.spec.initContainers : []) + (has(object.spec.ephemeralContainers) ? object.spec.ephemeralContainers : [])).all(c, (has(c.securityContext) && has(c.securityContext.runAsNonRoot)) ? c.securityContext.runAsNonRoot == true : (has(object.spec.securityContext) && has(object.spec.securityContext.runAsNonRoot) && object.spec.securityContext.runAsNonRoot == true)) && (object.spec.containers + (has(object.spec.initContainers) ? object.spec.initContainers : []) + (has(object.spec.ephemeralContainers) ? object.spec.ephemeralContainers : [])).all(c, !(has(c.securityContext) && has(c.securityContext.runAsUser) && c.securityContext.runAsUser == 0))
checks.remediation: Configure runAsNonRoot: true in container securityContext.

checks.name: Privilege escalation disabled
checks.description: Blocks privilege escalation flag across all containers in the pod.
checks.celExpression: has(object.spec) && has(object.spec.containers) && size(object.spec.containers) > 0 && ((!has(object.spec.os) || !has(object.spec.os.name) || object.spec.os.name != 'windows') ? (object.spec.containers + (has(object.spec.initContainers) ? object.spec.initContainers : []) + (has(object.spec.ephemeralContainers) ? object.spec.ephemeralContainers : [])).all(c, has(c.securityContext) && has(c.securityContext.allowPrivilegeEscalation) && c.securityContext.allowPrivilegeEscalation == false) : true)
checks.remediation: Set allowPrivilegeEscalation: false in container securityContext.

checks.name: Privileged mode disabled
checks.description: Strictly forbids container execution with privileged host device access.
checks.celExpression: has(object.spec) && has(object.spec.containers) && size(object.spec.containers) > 0 && (object.spec.containers + (has(object.spec.initContainers) ? object.spec.initContainers : []) + (has(object.spec.ephemeralContainers) ? object.spec.ephemeralContainers : [])).all(c, !(has(c.securityContext) && has(c.securityContext.privileged) && c.securityContext.privileged == true))
checks.remediation: Remove privileged: true from container securityContext.

checks.name: Immutable event logging sink active
checks.description: Ensures security-relevant agent lifecycle and access events are forwarded to audit sink.
checks.remediation: Configure event_logging_enabled: true in agent audit configuration.

checks.name: Read-only root filesystem
checks.description: Configures containers with read-only root filesystems to prevent runtime tampering.
checks.celExpression: has(object.spec) && has(object.spec.containers) && size(object.spec.containers) > 0 && (object.spec.containers + (has(object.spec.initContainers) ? object.spec.initContainers : []) + (has(object.spec.ephemeralContainers) ? object.spec.ephemeralContainers : [])).all(c, has(c.securityContext) && has(c.securityContext.readOnlyRootFilesystem) && c.securityContext.readOnlyRootFilesystem == true)
checks.remediation: Enable readOnlyRootFilesystem: true in container securityContext.

checks.name: Cryptographic SVID identity presentation
checks.description: Requires valid cryptographic SVID presentation for all inter-service communications.
checks.remediation: Authenticate using an issued X.509 or JWT SPIFFE SVID credential.

checks.name: All capabilities dropped
checks.description: Strips Linux kernel capabilities to establish strict container isolation boundary. The ALL token is compared exactly, as Pod Security Admission compares it: a lowercase "all" is rejected by a restricted namespace, so it fails here.
checks.celExpression: has(object.spec) && has(object.spec.containers) && size(object.spec.containers) > 0 && (object.spec.containers + (has(object.spec.initContainers) ? object.spec.initContainers : []) + (has(object.spec.ephemeralContainers) ? object.spec.ephemeralContainers : [])).all(c, has(c.securityContext) && has(c.securityContext.capabilities) && has(c.securityContext.capabilities.drop) && c.securityContext.capabilities.drop.exists(d, d == 'ALL') && (!has(c.securityContext.capabilities.add) || c.securityContext.capabilities.add.all(a, a == 'NET_BIND_SERVICE')))

checks.name: Network boundary ingress isolation
checks.description: Verifies NetworkPolicy isolation is active for workload boundaries.
checks.remediation: Attach default-deny ingress NetworkPolicy to agent namespace.

checks.name: Continuous runtime anomaly monitoring
checks.description: Monitors runtime telemetry streams for anomalous tool invocation patterns.

controls.name: SI-7 Software, Firmware, and Information Integrity

checks.name: Immutable container image digest
checks.description: Ensures container images are pinned by immutable cryptographic SHA-256 digest.
checks.celExpression: has(object.spec) && has(object.spec.containers) && size(object.spec.containers) > 0 && (object.spec.containers + (has(object.spec.initContainers) ? object.spec.initContainers : []) + (has(object.spec.ephemeralContainers) ? object.spec.ephemeralContainers : [])).all(c, has(c.image) && c.image.matches('@sha256:[a-f0-9]{64}$'))
checks.remediation: Reference images by immutable sha256 digest.

checks.name: Image from trusted registry
checks.description: Every container, init container and ephemeral container image comes from a trusted organisation prefix (listed in AGENT-CONTEXT.md); a whole public registry is never trusted.
checks.celExpression: has(object.spec) && has(object.spec.containers) && size(object.spec.containers) > 0 && (object.spec.containers + (has(object.spec.initContainers) ? object.spec.initContainers : []) + (has(object.spec.ephemeralContainers) ? object.spec.ephemeralContainers : [])).all(c, has(c.image) && (c.image.startsWith('zot.local/') || c.image.startsWith('registry.internal/') || c.image.startsWith('ghcr.io/controlplaneio/') || c.image.startsWith('ghcr.io/controlplaneio-in-toto/') || c.image.startsWith('ghcr.io/controlplaneio-fluxcd/') || c.image.startsWith('gcr.io/distroless/')))
checks.remediation: Deploy images sourced exclusively from trusted registries.
